messages:
Zara Hussein: hey everyone :wave: Zara here  just started in Product. quick q: I filled out the benefit forms but didnt get the snack preference survey. is that still open? also who should i ping about monitor riser?
People Ops: welcome Zara!! the snack survey goes out separately via email from perks@redwood. it sometimes lands in promotions so check that folder. ping me if you dont see it and we can add preferences manually.
Zara Hussein: thanks! im vegetarian and allergic to peanuts, noted.
MDM Bot: Hi Zara  please enroll any device you plan to use: https://mdm.example.com/enroll · Reply with "need-laptop" if you need a company machine.
Ben Castillo: hey Zara, im on product design. welcome! if you want a monitor riser we have a small stock, DM me your desk setup and ill arrange delivery. also we have a whiteboard in the product room you can reserve via calendar.
Maya Li: adding welcome from the eng team  i can do a quick walkthrough of our roadmap and how product/infra work together. also thx for flagging dietary restrictions, well note it for in-person events.
Sam Wells: for VPN and SSH follow the usual quickstart; ill ping you a short checklist.
Zara Hussein: small fun fact: i used to compete in slam poetry :microphone: happy to share a piece at the all-hands open mic.
Zara Hussein: also RSVPd virtual lunch :salad: see you all there!
